parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The cluster name based on which the system performs fuzzy searches among the clusters that belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs describe-clusters --name test --cluster-type ManagedKubernetes --resource-group-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cs GET /clusters --region cn-hangzhou --clusterType ManagedKubernetes --resource_group_id 'example-string' --name test --header "Content-Type=application/json"
